images.altText: Full-body painted portrait of Falanaras, a pale white-haired blood elf in black-and-crimson Blood Knight armor, standing nearly front-facing with a curved red-gold sword lowered beside him against a warm abstract Thalassian archway.
images.prompt:
## Intended use
Fresh unattached canonical-appearance candidate for Falanaras in his default Blood Knight outfit; neutral frontal character study and direct replication test of the user-supplied Wretched painting's visual style. This is project-library concept art, not a cover or page illustration.

## Scene and background
Falanaras stands alone in a calm, nearly front-facing full-body character portrait, wearing his complete Blood Knight outfit. His curved Thalassian sword is lowered diagonally beside him in a natural resting-ready position, secondary to the readable face, heraldry, armor, and silhouette.

## Subjects
One adult male blood elf, Falanaras, protagonist and two-handed Blood Knight. His identity, costume, heraldry, hair, faceguard, and weapon design come from the supplied in-game screenshots.

## Appearance and continuity anchors
Faithfully translate the screenshot design: pale ivory skin; narrow angular adult blood-elf face; luminous green eyes; long pointed ears; straight white-blond hair with two long front locks and a thick high ponytail. Compact open crimson-and-ivory forehead guard leaving the face visible. Fitted charcoal-black and dark-gray Blood Knight armor with crimson edging, layered angular shoulders, substantial bracers and gauntlets, red-banded greaves, black pointed boots, long dark tabard and coat panels, large crimson phoenix centered on the chest, and a faceted red belt gem. Preserve the screenshot's curved asymmetrical pale-metal sword, dark warm hilt, and close orange/red-gold magical energy. Refine low-resolution game geometry into the same stylized painted Warcraft design rather than redesigning it.

## Action
Standing still in controlled readiness. The lowered curved sword rests on a gentle diagonal beside the body, held naturally and without foreshortening or aggressive projection toward the viewer.

## Expression, pose, and gaze
Centered, nearly frontal neutral pose inspired only by the compositional stance of the supplied Gothic test: upright, shoulders level, feet planted, weight balanced, arms relaxed around the lowered weapon, direct or slightly off-center gaze. Severe, watchful, emotionally contained expression conveying discipline, fatigue, and moral burden rather than triumph. Keep anatomy and sword handling coherent, but allow the screenshot weapon reference to determine natural relative scale and construction.

## Setting and environment
A subdued, softly abstract Thalassian interior field: near-black and deep wine shadows, faint tall blood-elf arch shapes, muted warm stone, restrained crimson ornament, and smoky amber-red haze. The setting remains subordinate and dissolves into painterly atmosphere around the full figure. Do not inherit the icy tunnel or blue-periwinkle palette of the Wretched reference.

## Style, medium, and palette
Replicate the supplied Wretched painting's classic polished Warcraft illustration language: hand-painted digital fantasy art with stylized planar anatomy, confident visible brush passages, broken color transitions, selective contour accents, rich opaque color, and varied hard, soft, and lost edges. Faces, eyes, heraldry, hands, and focal equipment receive crisp selective definition while armor planes, hair edges, haze, and background dissolve more freely. Avoid uniformly smooth airbrushed gradients and glossy CGI/render surfaces. Preserve Warcraft's stylized proportions and bold costume landmarks. Palette: pale ivory skin, white-blond hair, near-black and charcoal armor, deep crimson edging and phoenix, restrained fel green eyes, pale metal, concentrated orange/red-gold magic, and a warm dark Thalassian background.

## Camera and framing
Eye-level full-body portrait, nearly front-on, centered, with the entire forehead guard, ears, ponytail, hands, sword, tabard, legs, and boots visible. No dramatic wide-angle distortion and no blade thrust toward the camera.

## Composition
Stable vertical character silhouette centered in the frame, drawing from the Gothic test only for its calm near-frontal stance and lowered diagonal weapon presentation. Face and crimson phoenix are the primary focal points; belt gem and sword are secondary. Faint Thalassian arches frame rather than compete with the figure. Maintain modest atmospheric breathing room around the silhouette without creating an empty text zone.

## Purposeful use of space
Unless the brief explicitly calls for a sparse, minimalist, isolated-study, or open-field composition, concentrate quiet negative space only in explicit text-reservation regions. Everywhere else, make each area contribute to subject, setting, atmosphere, depth, scale, motion, focus, or visual flow without adding clutter. Atmospheric open space is purposeful when it clearly establishes mood or scale; avoid large unmotivated blank areas and do not invent a text landing zone where none was requested.

## Lighting and mood
Controlled warm-neutral portrait light on the pale face and white hair, with deep wine and charcoal shadows. Restrained orange/red-gold weapon light warms nearby armor and tabard. Grave, austere, disciplined, and morally burdened.

## Reference image roles (actual provider input order)
Provider input image 1: Primary canonical identity, front outfit, heraldry, faceguard, and weapon-design reference for Falanaras. Preserve: Pale angular face, green eyes, white-blond front locks and high ponytail, compact open red-and-ivory forehead guard, black-and-crimson armor, phoenix chest emblem, belt gem, tabard, boots, and the natural relative design and scale of the curved luminous sword.. Must change: Replace the rigid game-model idle pose, black screenshot field, low-resolution geometry, and flat materials with the neutral painted portrait, natural anatomy, warm abstract Thalassian setting, and Wretched-reference brushwork.. Image id: 028de323-17a7-443d-be32-1bec84489db9.
Provider input image 2: Secondary identity, armor-profile, ponytail, and sword-construction reference for Falanaras. Preserve: Recognizable side facial structure, pointed ear, high ponytail volume, layered armor, long tabard, curved asymmetrical pale-metal blade, hilt construction, and close orange/red-gold magical energy.. Must change: Turn the figure toward the specified nearly frontal neutral pose; avoid screenshot rendering, three-quarter idle stance, and black background.. Image id: 75bf57fa-3d0f-430d-8fbf-eabe7c8a1c52.
Provider input image 3: Sole painting-style reference. Preserve: Classic polished hand-painted Warcraft illustration, stylized planar modeling, visible brush passages, broken color transitions, selective crisp facial and hand detail, saturated opaque color, and varied hard, soft, and lost edges.. Must change: Do not copy the Wretched creature, crouching pose, armor, icy architecture, blue-periwinkle palette, snow, or composition. Apply the painting language to Falanaras in a warm dark Thalassian portrait.. Image id: 4a08dea9-b7bb-4e28-8712-bf672b4e9d2c.
Provider input image 4: Pose and composition reference only. Preserve: Calm centered near-front full-body stance, tall stable silhouette, readable chest heraldry, planted feet, and a lowered weapon forming a secondary diagonal beside the body.. Must change: Do not preserve the graphic linework, hard cel-like shadows, near-black poster treatment, redesigned ornate armor, enlarged sword, exact face, or exact hand arrangement. Use the screenshots for design and the Wretched image for all rendering.. Image id: fb1f26b0-1932-4ad7-9488-595f8544c1ba.

## Constraints and exclusions
Use the screenshots as authority for Falanaras's identity, outfit, color blocking, heraldry, forehead guard, and sword design. Use the Wretched image solely for painting technique, edge hierarchy, stylized modeling, and Warcraft illustration finish, not its creature, pose, armor, blue palette, or icy setting. Use the Gothic test solely for neutral centered near-front pose and lowered-weapon composition, not its graphic style, armor redesign, enlarged weapon, or detailing. Exactly one character and one sword; coherent anatomy and natural grip. Let the screenshot references determine the weapon's relative scale rather than imposing numeric size. No glossy 3D-render appearance, photorealism, cel-shaded graphic treatment, text, letters, logo, signature, watermark, border, or UI.

## Creative latitude
Meet every stated story, continuity, composition, and output requirement. Freely compose visual details that are not prescribed by the brief or references so the result feels intentional and coherent. Do not infer that unspecified details are forbidden, and do not add literal exclusions such as 'nothing else'.

## Rendered-text policy
Do not render words, letters, numbers, captions, labels, signatures, watermarks, logos, or story copy. Keep all story text as editable Lorekeeper text outside the raster image.

## Output target and protected regions
Raster size: 1024x1024. Aspect ratio: 1:1.
